data.title: Margaret Hamilton, computing pioneer who led software development for the Apollo program, dies at 90
data.description: Margaret H. Hamilton, a profoundly influential computer scientist best known for leading the software engineering team at MIT’s Instrumentation Lab during NASA’s Apollo program, died at age 90.
